description: Whether the bot block needs every temperature. Each strong network's policy is read at eleven temperatures and the 20k human profile's at twelve, and a temperature only reshapes one policy, so the extra columns are functions of the first plus what the reshaping exposes about the other moves. `all` is the shipped block; `one` keeps one member per family (each network at temperature 1, the 20k profile's plain rank file); `two` adds one more per family (each network at 0.2, the 20k profile at 3). `residual` is a different cut — every temperature kept, the transformer network's bot family dropped whole — and separates what that bot adds from what its temperatures add. The per-rank human files, the heuristic and the SGF-evaluation column are in every arm. EVERY ARM HOLDS OUT WHOLE PROBLEMS and runs at FOUR SEEDS: within a seed the arms hold aside the same problems and their delta is paired, across seeds nothing may be subtracted. The panel reaches the held-out likelihood and the shipped parameter distributions only — it re-maps no ranks and projects no per-cell vectors.
